subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured span/duration contract, and which reported event families should be lifecycle spans rather than point events?
rationale: Changing trajectory rows from event-only records to duration-bearing spans affects exported diagnostic schema, support tooling, and transcript-derived tool call/result semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Route latency measurement to OTel and update trajectory docs to say these rows are ordered diagnostic events, not spans.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle duration separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each family gets the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current code blame and documented telemetry ownership point to Vincent Koc for the schema decision.
